purpose: Original-assertion baseline for the three files implicated in the reported five failures of the phase-2 full suite. This is a targeted baseline, not a stage full-suite rerun.

method.source: git archive of committed 8efaefc, extracted to a fresh /tmp directory
method.dependencies: symlink to the existing project node_modules; no installation
method.globalSetup: Omitted deliberately: these three spec files contain no HTTP tests and use only in-memory or temporary SQLite databases.

tests.name: makes four distinct supported kit homes without moving or duplicating the durable entrance
seats the fixed 41-object sample dry on one shared field with room for the same remodels
derives bounded, outward-facing decorative route geometry from shared data and physical graded ground
tests.failure: AssertionError: expected 800 to be less than 200

tests.name: walks from the real door approach over the court to natural ground and back up the entry steps at radius 21.6
approaches the house from sloped natural ground but cannot walk through its front wall
retains seeded vegetation at the enlarged radius within the existing terrain budget and disposes added route geometry
uses legal player blueprints, authentic content hashes, ordinary placement and unchanged capacity limits
walks all delivery/boarding bearings through the central alley with shared colliders
enters all sixteen rooms through real open-door parts and keeps ceiling jumps safe
fences old public batches while leaving existing private ground rows and content unchanged
upgrades a valid private v3 airborne save without changing position, height, velocity or jump latch
requires pickup and proximity, and replays both transitions without duplicate delivery
validates character, nonfinite or off-sphere coordinates, and impossible travel
stores identity-specific coat and delivery across an actual database close/reopen

comparison.interpretation: The obsolete curved-road triangle budget was already failing at stage 8efaefc. The removed decorative route object and the three physics-version expectations first became failing between the compared stages. This establishes chronology; it does not itself classify obsolete test assertions as production implementation defects.
